classes.name: Warrior
classes.tagline: Tough and steady. Big HP, heavy hits. Rage: gains MP when hit.

classes.name: Mage
classes.tagline: Fragile, but burns and freezes everything.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.tagline: Quick and deadly. Strikes twice, crits often.

items.name: Thornheart Blade

items.description: A dagger grown from a single great thorn.

items.name: Steel Broadsword
items.description: Reedwatch steel. Heavy, honest and sharp.

items.name: Yew Staff
items.description: Hits with magic. Scales with INT.

items.name: Fenwatch Stiletto
items.description: A scout's blade, thin enough to slip through mail.

items.name: Tidebreaker
items.description: A sea-green blade that drags at whatever it cuts.

items.name: Stormcleaver
items.description: Sparks jump from its edge on every swing.

items.name: Tidecaller Rod
items.description: Driftwood and pearl. The air around it is always damp.

items.name: Sparkglass Wand
items.description: A wand of fused lightning-glass. It crackles in damp air.

items.name: Brinefang
items.description: A kris with a salt-crusted wavy blade. Its cuts sting.

items.name: Sparkfang
items.description: A crackling spur on a copper hilt. It bites twice.

items.name: Thunderhead Maul
items.description: Forged around a Stormcoil scale. Every blow rumbles.

items.name: Stormcoil Scepter
items.description: A coil of living lightning caged in silver.

items.name: Coilfang
items.description: A serpent fang that still hums with stored lightning.

items.name: Traveler's Garb
items.description: Simple cloth. Better than nothing.

items.name: Novice Robe
items.description: Thin cloth with a few protective stitches.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: Good against claws and blades.

items.name: Apprentice Robe
items.description: Woven with warding runes. Shrugs off a little fire.

items.name: Scale Mail
items.description: Overlapping steel scales. Heavy, but it stops a lot.

items.name: Reedweave Robe
items.description: Woven from warded marsh reeds. Turns spells aside.

items.name: Marshhide Vest
items.description: Oiled lurker hide. Water runs right off it.

items.name: Stormweave Robe
items.description: Threads of wisp-silk ground the lightning.

items.name: Superior Health Potion
items.description: Restores 180 HP.

items.name: Superior Mana Potion
items.description: Restores 80 MP.

items.name: Tempered Longsword
items.description: Hearthold steel, quenched in snowmelt.

items.name: Larchwood Staff
items.description: Mountain larch, banded in iron and warm to the touch.

items.name: Ridgerunner Kris
items.description: A wavy blade for climbers who fight light.

items.name: Ridgeplate
items.description: Thick plates over a fur lining. Keeps out claws and cold.

items.name: Fleecewool Robe
items.description: Mountain wool stitched with warding runes.

items.name: Frostbite
items.description: A pale blade rimed with frost that never melts.

items.name: Hoarfrost Staff
items.description: Ice crystals grow along it overnight.

items.name: Icicle Kris
items.description: Sharp, cold and a little too eager.

items.name: Hearthfire Blade
items.description: Forged over the Hearthold fire. It smells of pine smoke.

items.name: Kindling Rod
items.description: A rod of charred wood with an ember that will not go out.

items.name: Salamander Kris
items.description: Scale-hilted and always warm.

items.name: Frostpelt Vest
items.description: Wolf pelt over boiled leather. Cold slides right off.

items.name: Galeweave Robe
items.description: Woven on the windiest ridge in the Frostfangs.

items.name: Snowmaw Cleaver
items.description: Hewn from the old beast's ice-hard tusk.

items.name: Mawtooth Staff
items.description: A staff crowned with one of Snowmaw's teeth.

items.name: Snowmaw Claw
items.description: A curved claw set in a bone grip.

items.name: Whiteout
items.description: A greatsword that howls like a blizzard when swung.

items.name: Squall Stave
items.description: The Frostbinder's own stave. The wind still answers it.

items.name: Galecutter
items.description: So light it seems to cut before you swing.

items.name: Recall Scroll
items.description: Takes you back to the last town you visited. One way: you walk back out. Not in battle.

items.name: Stone of Might
items.description: Re-rolls the Damage line of a weapon to a new random value (it can go up or down; high rolls are rare). Takes one stone per gear tier.

items.name: Stone of Precision
items.description: Re-rolls the Crit chance line of a weapon to a new random value (it can go up or down; high rolls are rare). Takes one stone per gear tier.

items.name: Stone of Warding
items.description: Re-rolls the Defense line of a piece of armor to a new random value (it can go up or down; high rolls are rare). Takes one stone per gear tier.

items.name: Stone of Vigor
items.description: Re-rolls the Max HP line of a piece of armor to a new random value (it can go up or down; high rolls are rare). Takes one stone per gear tier.

items.name: Leather Cap
items.description: Boiled leather. Keeps branches out of your eyes.

items.name: Leather Gloves
items.description: Stiff at first, then like a second skin.

items.name: Leather Boots
items.description: Made for long roads and wet paths.

items.name: Apprentice Hood
items.description: Warding thread stitched round the rim.

items.name: Apprentice Wraps
items.description: Cloth wraps that keep the fingers nimble for spells.

items.name: Apprentice Slippers
items.description: Soft soles, quiet steps.

items.name: Copper Band
items.description: A plain band that makes the arm feel heavier, in a good way.

items.name: Moonstone Ring
items.description: Cool to the touch, and quietly humming.

items.name: Fox Ring
items.description: A tiny fox curls around the finger.

items.name: Oak Pendant
items.description: A carved acorn on a leather cord.

items.name: Scale Coif
items.description: A hood of small steel scales.

items.name: Scale Gauntlets
items.description: Scaled cuffs over padded leather.

items.name: Scale Boots
items.description: Heavy, but they keep the bog out.

items.name: Reedweave Hood
items.description: Woven reeds with a faint blue glow in the weave.

items.name: Reedweave Wraps
items.description: Light, dry and covered in tiny runes.

items.name: Reedweave Slippers
items.description: They float. Nobody knows why.

items.name: Silver Band
items.description: Polished smooth by years of sword grips.

items.name: Tidepearl Ring
items.description: A pearl that is always a little damp.

items.name: Eelskin Ring
items.description: Slippery. Makes your hands quicker, somehow.

items.name: Stormglass Amulet
items.description: A bead of fused glass with a spark trapped inside.

items.name: Ridgeplate Helm
items.description: Thick steel over a fur lining.

items.name: Ridgeplate Gauntlets
items.description: Fur-lined, so fingers still bend in the cold.

items.name: Ridgeplate Boots
items.description: Spiked soles for ice.

items.name: Fleecewool Hood
items.description: Warm wool with blue warding runes.

items.name: Fleecewool Mittens
items.description: Spellwork in mittens. Hearthold insists.

items.name: Fleecewool Boots
items.description: Fur inside, runes outside.

items.name: Gold Band
items.description: Heavy gold. Heavy hands.

items.name: Rimeglass Ring
items.description: Ice that never melts, set in silver.

items.name: Wolfclaw Ring
items.description: A claw curled into a ring. Still sharp.

items.name: Hearthstone Pendant
items.description: A warm red stone from the Steamvent Caves.

items.name: Thornwarden Helm

items.name: Thornwarden Gloves
items.description: Thorny knuckles. Mind the handshake.

items.name: Thornwarden Boots
items.description: Roots for laces.

items.name: Thornwarden Band

items.name: Stormwatch Boots
items.description: Waterproof, mostly.

items.name: Frostward Helm

items.name: Frostward Gloves
items.description: White fur cuffs over rime-steel.

items.name: Frostward Boots

items.name: Frostward Ring

monsters.name: Hedge Troll
monsters.trait: Thick hide: Poison eats through. Use Gas Shot!

monsters.name: Mossling
monsters.trait: Bursts into spores once when hurt.

monsters.name: Thornback Boar
monsters.trait: Opens with a Thorn Charge.

monsters.name: Ash Imp
monsters.trait: Flares up once when hurt: +30% damage.

monsters.name: Bramble Bandit
monsters.trait: Opens with a Dirty Trick (may Blind).

monsters.name: Barkshell Beetle
monsters.trait: Shells up every 3rd move (-25% damage taken).

monsters.name: The Thornheart
monsters.trait: Every 3rd move: winds up Root Crush. Defend on the beat!

attacks.name: Root Crush
attacks.windup: The Thornheart sinks its roots deep into the earth... (Defend or heal!)

heroic.text: Seed Burst every 4th move: Spores and Poison at once.

monsters.name: Mire Toad
monsters.trait: Wallows once when hurt: heals 25%. Finish it fast.

monsters.name: Spark Wisp
monsters.trait: Flickers out of reach every 3rd move (-40% to hit it).

monsters.name: Bog Lurker
monsters.trait: Ambushes from the mud: its first blow hits hard.

monsters.name: Sunken Revenant
monsters.trait: Rises once at low HP, healing 30%.

monsters.name: Stormcrest Heron
monsters.trait: Every 3rd move: Crest Spark (Shock).

monsters.name: Volt Eel
monsters.trait: Absorbs Energy: lightning heals it. Every 3rd move: Discharge.

monsters.name: The Bogmother
monsters.trait: Every 3rd: Drag Under (Defend!). Every 4th: heals 12%.

attacks.name: Drag Under
attacks.windup: The Bogmother sinks into the mire, reaching for your legs... (Defend or heal!)

heroic.text: Leech Swarm every 4th move: a long Poison.

monsters.name: The Stormcoil
monsters.trait: Big hit every 3rd move. At half HP: Energy turns to Water.

heroic.text: Opens with Overcharge: +30% damage for 3 turns.

attacks.name: Thunderhead
attacks.windup: Storm clouds gather around the Stormcoil... (Defend or heal!)

phase.text: The Stormcoil sheds its crackling skin! Beneath, its scales run with seawater. It is a Water creature now.

attacks.name: Tidal Crush
attacks.windup: The Stormcoil rears up and pulls a wall of water behind it... (Defend or heal!)

monsters.name: Drift Wolf
monsters.trait: Opens with a Howl: +30% damage for 3 turns.

monsters.name: Crag Ram
monsters.trait: Every 3rd move: winds up a Headlong Charge.

attacks.name: Headlong Charge
attacks.windup: The Crag Ram paws the snow and lowers its horns... (Defend!)

monsters.name: Gust Sprite
monsters.trait: Swirls out of reach every 3rd move (-40% to hit it).

monsters.name: Rime Acolyte
monsters.trait: Mends once at half HP: heals 25%.

monsters.name: Glacier Golem
monsters.trait: Hardens every 3rd move (-25% damage taken).

monsters.name: Ember Salamander
monsters.trait: Absorbs Fire: flames heal it.

monsters.name: Vent Tortoise
monsters.trait: Opens with a Steam Burst (Burn).

monsters.name: Old Snowmaw
monsters.trait: Every 3rd move: winds up Avalanche. Defend on the beat!

attacks.name: Avalanche
attacks.windup: Old Snowmaw rears up and roars. Snow starts to slide off the slope above... (Defend or heal!)

heroic.text: Whiteout Roar every 4th move: Chill and Blind.

monsters.name: The Frostbinder
monsters.trait: Big hit every 3rd move. At half HP: turns Wind (Blizzard).

heroic.text: Shatter every 5th move: a heavy Ice blow.

attacks.name: Glacial Prison
attacks.windup: The Frostbinder raises her stave. Ice crawls across the floor toward you... (Defend or heal!)

phase.text: The Frostbinder presses a hand to the dragon's ice and drinks its strength! She dissolves into a howling blizzard. She is a Wind creature now.

attacks.name: Cyclone
attacks.windup: The wind screams into a funnel around the Frostbinder... (Defend or heal!)

attacks.name: Lid Slam
attacks.windup: The mimic opens its lid wide. Very wide... (Defend!)

npcs.name: Odo
npcs.title: Carter
dialogue: Brindlemoor is just up the road, west. The hedges are full of pests, but they barely bite. Pick up what they drop: you will want more than a weapon.
Something big came out of the hedges last night and tipped my cart. It went toward the town gate.
Me? I will sit here with my broken wheel until someone from town comes by. Go on.

npcs.name: Pell
npcs.title: Gatekeeper
dialogue: Brindlemoor is shut! That thing sat down right in front of the gate, and I climbed out over the wall.
Steel alone will take all day. Every beast has a weak spot: look at what it is weak to, and hit it there.
Once it is gone: Tobin sells gear, Ilsa has beds, and Elder Maren always has work for a new blade.

lines: Brindlemoor's gate, barred shut.
Something big squats in front of it, breathing slow and heavy.

boss.intro: It squats in front of the gate and will not budge.

npcs.name: Elder Maren
npcs.title: Town Elder
dialogue: Ah, a new face. Welcome to Brindlemoor.
Since the old dragon went quiet, the Thornwood has grown restless. Imps, boars, bandits...
Grow strong out there. Visit Tobin for gear and Ilsa when you need rest. The forest is east, through the gate.

npcs.name: Tobin
npcs.title: Shopkeeper
dialogue: Best prices this side of the river. Have a look!

npcs.name: Hulda
npcs.title: Smith
dialogue: Tobin's blades are honest, but they're plain. Bring me scrap, dust and whatever the wilds drop, and I'll make them sing.
I can reinforce what you carry, hone it, or break it down for parts.

npcs.name: Ilsa
npcs.title: Innkeeper
dialogue: A warm bed and a hot meal. You look like you need both.

npcs.name: Tamsin
npcs.title: Guild Clerk
dialogue: Adventurers' Guild. Pick a notice, bring proof, get paid. Do enough and the Guild ranks you up.

npcs.name: Garrick
npcs.title: Guard
dialogue: I keep watch on the forest road. Monsters do not get past me into town.
Monsters out there can see you coming. If one charges, fight or run. Can't outrun a boar for long, mind.

inspect.label: Torn note
lines: The boars are running the wrong way: out of the deep wood, not into it.
Whatever woke in the Hollow is not hunting them. It is pushing them out. We leave at first light. B.

inspect.label: Scored log
lines: Deep grooves across a fallen trunk. Not claws: roots, dragged through the wood like fingers.
A hunters' camp, left in a hurry. The fire pit is still warm.
Far off in the trees, something old creaks, like a door that has not opened in a hundred years.

inspect.label: Guild sign
lines: Woodcutters' Guild. No cutting past this sign. By order of Elder Maren.
Carved underneath, fresh: THE TREES CUT BACK.

inspect.label: Old stump
lines: Cut a week ago, by the look of it. It already has new shoots as long as your arm.
A clearing full of fresh stumps. The axes are still stuck in them.
The woodcutters left in a hurry. Deeper in, the trees grow so close the light turns green.

inspect.label: Bandit's tally
lines: Purses taken: 31. Lads lost to the trees: 6.
The forest is worse than the guards. Last night the brambles moved the path again.

inspect.label: Stolen crates
lines: Crates stamped with Tobin's mark. So that is where his spring stock went.

inspect.label: Old bones
lines: A deer, caught in the thorns and never let go. The vines grew right through it.

inspect.label: Thorns
lines: The thorns lean toward you while you look. When you step back, they settle.
The path ends in a wall of thorns as tall as a house.
It creaks in and out, slow and even, like something asleep behind it is breathing.

boss.intro: Ancient bark creaks as it turns toward you.

npcs.name: Captain Hale
npcs.title: Reedwatch Captain
dialogue: Reedwatch holds the only dry ground for a day's walk. My scouts and I keep it that way.
Past the causeway the water gets deep and the storms get strange. Watch your footing.

npcs.name: Wren
npcs.title: Quartermaster
dialogue: Steel from the city, potions from the Sister. Dry goods, mostly. Mostly dry.

npcs.name: Sister Ottilie
npcs.title: Healer
dialogue: Sit, rest, dry your boots. The fen takes its toll on everyone.

npcs.name: Ivo
npcs.title: Guild Clerk
dialogue: Same board as Brindlemoor, just wetter. Hunts in, coin out.

inspect.label: Warning post
lines: Scratched into the post: DON'T HIT THE EELS WITH LIGHTNING.
Under it, in another hand: we know now.

inspect.label: Fisher's slate
lines: Toads in the nets again, twice the size of last year's.
Mother is feeding them. We leave for Reedwatch tomorrow.

inspect.label: Gnawed stilt
lines: A stilt as thick as a man, bitten halfway through. The tooth marks are the size of your hand.
Fishers' huts on tall stilts, all empty. The boats are tied up high, out of the water's reach.
Out past the reeds, something big rolls over in the mud, and the whole pool slops against the stilts.

boss.intro: The pool bubbles, and something enormous heaves itself out of the mud.

inspect.label: Worn carving
lines: A shrine to the river, older than Reedwatch.
Someone has scratched a coiled serpent over the old carvings, again and again.

inspect.label: Offerings
lines: Fish bones and copper coins on the top step. Fresh. Someone still comes here to ask the storm for mercy.
Old stone steps lead down into the water. The rain falls sideways here.
Ahead, lightning strikes the same drowned stone, again and again, as if something down there is calling it.

boss.intro: Lightning crawls over the drowned stones. The Stormcoil uncoils from around a great, dull scale.

npcs.name: Sabine
npcs.title: Ranger
dialogue: Another one from the lowlands. You'll want a thicker coat.
Winter came early this year and never left. The ridge is crawling with things that like it that way.

npcs.name: Gunnar
npcs.title: Trader
dialogue: Mountain steel, mountain wool. Nothing fancy, nothing that breaks. I buy too, if it is not frozen solid.

npcs.name: Moll
npcs.title: Hearthkeeper
dialogue: Come in, come in, shut the door! The fire is the only warm thing left on this mountain.

npcs.name: Edda
npcs.title: Guild Clerk
dialogue: The Guild pays double the cold, or it feels that way. What will it be?

inspect.label: Old note
lines: Gone for water. If you read this, bring a bucket. M.
The ink has run in the steam. Nobody from Hearthold has made it down here since the snows came.
Warm water steams in a deep cave pool. For the first time since the pass, your fingers stop aching.
Whatever is chilling the mountain, its spell stops at the water's edge.

inspect.label: Ranger's log
lines: Day 40. The old bear has not slept all winter. She paces the den mouth like a dog on a chain.
Day 41. A woman in white came down from the roost. She spoke to the bear, and the bear sat. Going closer tomorrow. T.

inspect.label: Clawed door
lines: Deep claw marks on the door, on the outside. Whatever made them wanted in, then gave up.
A rangers' lookout, half buried in snow. The fire pit is cold and the door hangs open.
Further on, at the mouth of a den, a great white shape paces back and forth. Back and forth.

boss.intro: A snowbank stands up. It has eyes, and very large teeth.

inspect.label: Rune pillar
lines: The same rune Sabine found in the golem's core. Up close, the ice hums.
This cold is not weather. Someone is making it.

inspect.label: Footprints
lines: Small bare footprints in the snow. Whoever made them does not feel the cold.
Steps cut into the mountain, older than Hearthold. Blue runes glow in the ice on either side.
At the top, a light flickers behind a wall of ice. The wind sings one long, cold note.

boss.intro: Behind a wall of blue ice, something enormous sleeps. In front of it, a woman in white turns around and smiles.

quests.name: Heart of Thorns
offer: The moss, the bandits, the imps... it all points to one thing.
An ancient heartwood tree has woken in the hollow past the Deep Thornwood. The Thornheart. The thorn wall that blocks the path will part for you now.
Watch it closely. When it gathers its strength, brace yourself: Defend, or heal.
quests.reminder: The Thornheart waits in the hollow past the Deep Thornwood. Stock up on potions first.
complete: You did it. Listen... the forest is already quieter.
This was carved from the Thornheart itself. It belongs with you now.
I fear this is only the beginning. But tonight, Brindlemoor celebrates you.

quests.name: Rising Waters
offer: The Thornheart is gone, yet the land is still uneasy. Last night the river west of town burst its banks.
The Mirewater Fen is creeping toward our fields, and folk say it crackles like a storm that never breaks.
I've told Garrick to take down the barricade on the west road. Clear the Mire Toads off the Fen Road, four of them, then come back to me.
quests.reminder: Four Mire Toads on the Fen Road, west of town. Mind their tongues.
complete: Good. The road is passable again.
Past the Fen Road stands Reedwatch, an old outpost. Captain Hale holds it. Tell him I sent you, and take these: the fen is no place to run dry.

quests.name: Mother of the Mire
offer: The toads, the lurkers... they all crawl out of Bog Hollow, past the causeway. Something huge lives in that pool. We call her the Bogmother.
My men will cut a path through the reeds for you. She'll sink into the mud before a big strike: brace yourself.
quests.reminder: Bog Hollow is past the Sunken Causeway. When she sinks into the mire, defend or heal.
complete: The Bogmother, dead? The whole outpost will drink to you tonight.
But my scouts saw what lies beyond the hollow. An old shrine, half drowned... and lightning crawling over it.

quests.name: Eye of the Storm
offer: The storms, the wisps, the flood: it all comes from the Drowned Shrine. A great serpent coils there, around something that glows.
We'll clear the reeds past Bog Hollow. Be warned: my scouts swear it changed color while they watched. Bring more than one trick.
quests.reminder: The Drowned Shrine lies past Bog Hollow. Lightning first, then water. Bring both, or something neutral.
complete: The rain has stopped. For the first time in a month, I can see the stars over the fen.
And this... a scale as big as a shield, dull and cold. That is no serpent scale. That is a dragon's.
Take this, forged in our smithy around a piece of the Stormcoil. Then go tell Maren what you found. She will want to know about that scale.

quests.name: Cold Scale
offer: Let me see that scale. Hm. A dragon's scale should be warm, even shed. This one is cold as river ice, and look: frost, in my own kitchen.
The old dragon flew north to the Frostfangs, years ago. If something up there is chilling it, I want to know what.
I will have Garrick dig out the north gate. Mind the wolves on the pass: four of them, and the road is yours.
quests.reminder: The north gate is open. Four Drift Wolves on the Frostfang Pass, then on to Hearthold.
complete: Hearthold is just past the pass. Ask for Sabine; she knows those peaks better than anyone.
And take these. It is colder than it looks.

quests.name: The Old One in the Den
offer: The trail to the roost runs through a den past the ridge. Old Snowmaw lives there. She used to sleep through winter. Now she guards the way like a dog on a chain.
I will clear the drifts. Her hide is packed ice: hit her with fire until it cracks, or you are just knocking snow off.
And when she rears up and the slope starts to slide, Defend.
quests.reminder: Snowmaw's Den is past Windscour Ridge. Fire cracks her shell; it grows back once. Defend against the Avalanche.
complete: You beat Old Snowmaw? Then nothing stands between you and the roost but whoever made all this.
Rest first. You will need it.

quests.name: The Frozen Roost
offer: The dragon's roost is just past the den. My scouts saw a woman up there, all in white, and a wall of blue ice taller than the watchtower.
Whatever she is doing, it is why winter will not leave. Bring fire. And bring something for the wind: they say when she is angry, she turns into the storm.
quests.reminder: The Frozen Roost is past the den. Fire for the ice, Earth for the storm.
complete: The wind just... stopped. I can hear the meltwater running for the first time in a year.
You saw it? The dragon, in the ice? And it looked at you? Then it is alive. Maren will want to hear every word.
Take this. She left it behind when the storm blew itself out.

features.name: Elite monsters
features.text: Now and then a monster spawns as an Elite: bigger, glowing gold, with one affix. Tougher, but 3x XP and gold and a guaranteed piece of gear.

features.name: Treasure chests
features.text: Some monster rooms hide a chest. Walk into it for gold, materials and often gear.

features.name: Spare weapon
features.text: Carry a second weapon in the Spare slot (Inventory) and swap to it mid-fight with Swap. It costs your turn, so bring one of the element your foe is weak to.

features.name: Materials
features.text: Monsters now drop parts and elemental essences. They sit in their own pouch (Inventory, Materials tab). Keep them: they will matter soon.

features.name: Hulda's forge
features.text: Hulda the smith has opened her forge in Brindlemoor: craft gear from materials, reinforce it up to +10, hone its quality and salvage what you do not need.

features.name: Sigils
features.text: Dropped gear can now be a rare Sigil version: stronger, glowing, and with extra lines (Dawn +1, Dusk +2, Eclipse +3). Bosses drop them most.

features.name: Mimics
features.text: Some chests bite. Watch for one that breathes, or whose lid twitches when you come near.
